title: Projektledare / Klinisk Monitor (Clinical Research Associate - Oncology)
function_label: Clinical Research Associate (Monitor) — monitors clinical trial sites for GCP compliance and protocol adherence
language_evidence: Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska
requirements_mandatory: Naturvetenskaplig eller vårdrelaterad högskoleexamen (biomedicin, farmaci, sjuksköterska)
Dokumenterad erfarenhet som monitor eller projektledare inom kliniska prövningar
Goda kunskaper i ICH-GCP och svensk lagstiftning för klinisk forskning
requirements_desirable: Erfarenhet av akademiska prövningar och prövarinitierade studier (IIT)
clinsight_note: ClinSight Read: Ideal transition point for academic scientists (biomedicine/pharmacy) moving into professional CRA monitoring within Western Sweden's largest healthcare region.

title: Director, Medical & Payer Evidence Statistics
function_label: Biostatistician / Evidence Director — leads global HTA and payer statistical strategy
language_evidence: Global biometrics site; English working language, Swedish not required
requirements_mandatory: PhD or MSc in Biostatistics, Statistics, or Mathematical Sciences
7+ years biostatistics experience in late-phase clinical drug development
Demonstrated FDA/EMA health authority interaction experience
requirements_desirable: Real-world evidence (RWE) modeling and causal inference
Statistical programming in validated SAS & R environments
clinsight_note: ClinSight Read: Strategic leadership role at AstraZeneca's global R&D site in Mölndal/Gothenburg. Integrates clinical trial statistical outputs with global payer reimbursement evidence.

title: Klinisk Forskningssygeplejerske / Study Coordinator (Early Phase Unit)
function_label: Clinical Research Coordinator — runs early-phase first-in-human trials at the clinic
requirements_mandatory: Dokumenteret erfaring med klinisk onkologi eller hæmatologi
requirements_desirable: Erfaring med tidlig-fase basket- eller umbrella-protokoller
clinsight_note: ClinSight Read: Academic clinical trials unit embedded at Rigshospitalet. Excellent gateway for hospital clinicians into Medicon Valley biotech and pharma sponsor trials.

title: Senior Clinical Trial Biostatistician (Cardiovascular & Metabolic)
function_label: Biostatistician — designs statistical analysis plans (SAP) and defends trial evidence
language_evidence: Global R&D team; working language is English with no Scandinavian language requirement
requirements_mandatory: PhD or MSc in Biostatistics, Mathematical Statistics, or Data Science
5+ years biostatistical experience in registrational Phase 3 clinical trials
Advanced proficiency in validated SAS and R programming environments
requirements_desirable: Experience with GLP-1 / GIP outcome endpoints and time-to-event survival modeling
Participation in health authority advisory meetings (FDA / EMA / CHMP)
clinsight_note: ClinSight Read: High-level sponsor biometrics role leading registrational CVOT pipeline trials. 100% English working environment.

title: Clinical Research Scientist / Medical Monitor (Bispecific Immuno-Oncology)
function_label: Clinical Project / Study Scientist — leads trial execution and clinical scientific oversight
language_evidence: International R&D headquarters; English fluency required, Scandinavian not required
requirements_mandatory: MD, PharmD, or PhD in Immunology / Oncology Life Sciences
4+ years sponsor-side clinical trial monitoring and protocol execution
Working knowledge of EU CTR 536/2014 & CTIS submissions
requirements_desirable: Hands-on experience with T-cell engaging bispecific antibody trials
clinsight_note: ClinSight Read: Target role for PhD postdocs or industry research associates with immunology backgrounds transitioning into full sponsor-side clinical trial development.

title: Pharmacovigilance & Drug Safety Specialist
function_label: Pharmacovigilance Specialist — assesses adverse events, safety signal detection, and regulatory reporting
language_evidence: Research group working language is English; international applicants welcome
requirements_mandatory: Degree in Pharmacy, Biomedicine, Medicine, or Pharmacology
Understanding of CIOMS, MedDRA coding, and ICSR processing principles
Scientific analytical ability and fluent scientific English
requirements_desirable: Prior exposure to EudraVigilance or Argus safety databases
Knowledge of EU GVP (Good Pharmacovigilance Practices) modules
clinsight_note: ClinSight Read: Rare entry-level PV opportunity. Perfect gateway for life science graduates, pharmacists, or postdocs transitioning into pharmaceutical drug safety and regulatory intelligence.
